In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 5-space]], the '''5-orthoplex honeycomb''' is one of five paracompact [[regular polytope|regular]] space-filling [[tessellation]]s (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycombs]]). It is paracompact because it has infinite [[vertex figures]], with all vertices as [[ideal point]]s at infinity.  With [[Schläfli symbol]] {3,3,3,4,3}, it has three [[5-orthoplex]]es around each cell. It is [[dual polytope|dual]] to the [[24-cell honeycomb honeycomb]].

== Related honeycombs ==
Its [[vertex figure]] is the [[16-cell honeycomb]], {3,3,4,3}.
